meta.name: MITRE ATT&CK intrusion-set aliases
meta.note: Derived from MITRE ATT&CK Enterprise data. Cite MITRE ATT&CK when reusing. Aliases are naming labels, not proof of attribution.
meta.profile_match_rule: Exact match after splitting names on '/', removing generic words such as group, cyber, actors, and unit, and requiring at least four remaining characters. A match is a research link, not an attribution finding.
